posts.text: Alivus guiding 10-12% topline growth with 35-36% EBDITA. Sholapur plant to go on stream in Q3. Most interesting part of concall is announcement for foraying into Pellets ( formulation intermediates) and 2 years into Formulations on B2B basis. Actively contemplating building Oral formulations plant.
